explication: Quotio combines a native macOS command center with a Rust CLI for quota visibility, account management, local proxy/agent setup, and automation. The main user journey is to provide or discover provider credentials, fetch quota usage, then inspect it in the app, terminal, JSON, or local API. The map also preserves proxy lifecycle, agent configuration, and tunnel capabilities. The README and tree establish these product areas; sampled excerpts support only selected runtime links, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
